benefits.text: A gel that thickens the look of brows and keeps each brow hair in place. Soft, natural hold for perfectly groomed brows. Evenly coats even the hidden hairs underneath for fuller-looking brows. The specially designed brush tip is easy to use and does not cause clumping.

howToUse.text: Brush evenly through the brows. Can be used with a brow pencil to create signature, well-defined brows

safety.text:
For external use on the eye area only; avoid direct contact of the product with the eyes.
If it gets into the eyes, rinse thoroughly with water immediately and stop use if any unusual signs appear.

positioning.text: A clear brow shaping gel that helps keep brow hairs naturally in place without changing brow color.

sellingPoints.text: Soft, natural hold; evenly coats each brow hair; easy-to-use brush tip that minimises clumping.

texture.text: Clear brow gel, lightweight and easy to brush through.

claimDisclaimers.text: Do not claim absolute all-day hold or water resistance unless the source states it. “Thickening” should be understood as the effect of evenly coating brow hairs, not stimulating brow growth.

positioning.text: A grey-brown brow shaping gel that helps set brow hairs in place and make brow color look softer, cooler and more natural.

sellingPoints.text: Soft, natural hold; grey brown easily softens brow color; easy-to-use brush tip that minimises clumping.

texture.text: Tinted brow gel, lightweight and easy to brush through.

finish.text: Natural grey brown / groomed / soft hairs.

claimDisclaimers.text: Do not say it permanently changes brow color. Color payoff may vary depending on natural brow color.
